pinned_upload_source_waits.scope: Cumulative per-backend summary over the full scheduler lifetime (native + clean64K + diagnostic64K); backend totals may overlap and are not request wall time or direct wall-benefit estimates.
pinned_upload_source_waits.sample_log_scope: Individual lines are thresholded samples (>=1ms, capped); do not sum them as total waits.

device_tail_helper.coverage_basis: configured helper path/activation and runtime loaded marker; no kernel-name heuristic
device_tail_helper.parent_only_kernel_warning: R5 tail-only helper can dispatch child graph compute internally; CUPTI does not expose child compute. Symbol truncation is irrelevant because names are not used to decide coverage.

pinned_source_waits_whole_scheduler_life.scope: Cumulative per-backend summary over the full scheduler lifetime (native + clean64K + diagnostic64K); backend totals may overlap and are not request wall time or direct wall-benefit estimates.
pinned_source_waits_whole_scheduler_life.sample_log_scope: Individual lines are thresholded samples (>=1ms, capped); do not sum them as total waits.

interpretation_limits: Clean 64K result is complete and separately compared with clean V386/V373 baselines.
Only first target 32K has a complete phase window and valid CUPTI trace. The second target chunk was guard-stopped; there is no full diagnostic 64K throughput result.
CUPTI API intervals are in CUPTI-relative time for this aborted scenario because no result JSON preserved start/stop host brackets; exact host phase bounds still identify the captured first chunk.
R5 tail-only helper path/activation marks device child compute unobserved. Kernel symbols are not used for coverage classification and may be truncated.

Pinned source wait summary, if present, covers the whole scheduler lifetime (native+clean+diagnostic); per-backend totals may overlap and are not wall benefit. On this stopped run, absent summary means only capped long-wait examples are available.
